inicio.frasePago: PLANS PLUS, PRO or ÉLITE are paid in full when you ACTIVATE the one you chose, no later than 31 December 2026. From 1 January 2027 payment is made in full at the moment you ACTIVATE it. Creating an account under SIGN UP with any user type does not mean taking a PLAN. STARTER is not a plan: it is paid when you SIGN UP. Installments on an international card are set by your bank, not by drones.orientese.com.
inicio.fraseInformativo: This site drones.orientese.com offers only an informational service. It does not sell drones, parts or accessories. We only provide an informational service. Any published listing is the sole responsibility of the user.
inicio.slide2P1: Ranchers, cooperatives, construction firms, companies, schools, pilots, helpers, technicians, engineers and everyone linked to the world of Drones: we warmly invite you to sign up and use this new informational site, created to serve you in a useful and pleasant way.
inicio.slide2P2: From October through December 2026 you may sign up free of charge with your User Type and try the offered PLANS with BETA limits, then choose the one that suits you best and ACTIVATE it no later than 31 December 2026.
inicio.slide3P1: That is right: SIGN UP FREE with your USER TYPE and try the PLANS THAT SUIT YOU BEST until 31-12-2026, the deadline to switch plans and/or ACTIVATE the one you chose for 2027, with all plan benefits included + the guaranteed quota in the launch promotion for the first 1800 sign-ups of each PLAN worldwide, in its FIRST STAGE.
inicio.slide3P2: When you ACTIVATE the PLAN you chose (deadline 31-12-2026) you make the FULL PAYMENT with an approved international credit card, in the installments you agree with your bank.
inicio.slide4P1: The PLANS you may choose, according to your needs, are detailed under PLANS; you may sign up free of charge, by User Type, under SIGN UP.
inicio.slide4P2: The PLANS are designed for each user according to what we consider possible daily and monthly use, given their activities.
inicio.slide4P3: The price of each one relates to what could be less than the cost of a coffee a day at a café of your choice.
inicio.slide4P4: The benefits relate to what we estimate you may need to find what you seek, directly, with no middlemen, no commissions and by mutual agreement.
inicio.slide4P5: There can be many possibilities and many opportunities.
inicio.slide5P1: Until 31 December 2026 you may sign up free of charge with the User Type you prefer in the SIGN UP section and thereby secure a quota in the launch promotion First Stage (E1).
inicio.slide5P2: This promotion lasts 60 days from 1 January 2027, or until 1800 ACTIVATED PLANS worldwide are reached, whichever comes first, and may be extended in a country where needed.
inicio.slide5P4: First Stage: 10% off PLAN PLUS (Consistent) — 15% off PLAN PRO (Friend) and 20% off PLAN ÉLITE (Ally).
inicio.slide5P5: Second Stage: 7% off PLAN PLUS (Consistent) — 12% off PLAN PRO (Friend) and 17% off PLAN ÉLITE (Ally).
inicio.slide5P6: Third Stage: 5% off PLAN PLUS (Consistent) — 10% off PLAN PRO (Friend) and 15% off PLAN ÉLITE (Ally).
inicio.slide5P7: Plus the benefits of each PLAN, which you can see under PLANS. You may SIGN UP NOW and START TRYING the BENEFITS of the selected PLAN, or remain a VISITOR only; we suggest joining this new Site and inviting good friends to this large family, writing together the best flight logs for each service given. Success always.

faq.q1: Does the site sell drones or parts?
faq.a1: No. It only informs. It does not sell, broker or charge commission.
faq.q2: Can I use the hub in BETA?
faq.a2: Yes. Until 31/12/2026 you may sign up, try PLANS, publish notices, jobs and FOR SALE items, and see the payment flow. There is no charge in this period.
faq.q3: Why is the payment form visible if it does not charge?
faq.a3: So you can see how a PLAN is activated. The gateway does not charge yet. Charging and invoices come later. Installments on an international card are set by the bank, not by this site.
faq.q4: Is creating an account the same as taking a PLAN?
faq.a4: No. Sign-up does not mean PLUS, PRO or ÉLITE. STARTER is not a plan.
faq.a5: No. They expire on 31/12/2026. The publisher is responsible for the notice.
faq.q6: Why are some languages missing from the menu?
faq.a6: Official versions are now Portuguese, Spanish and English. Other languages return when complete. You may use the browser translator on visible text; that does not replace the official versions.
